tools.name: find_mail_server
tools.description: Looks up the mail server of an e-mail address and tells what the user must do before mail2mail can log in (for example: Gmail and iCloud need an app password, GMX and WEB.DE need IMAP switched on). Optional: start_move looks the servers up by itself. Use it to prepare the user before asking for pass

tools.name: start_move
tools.description: Copies all e-mail (every folder) from old mailboxes to new ones: one mailbox, or up to 50 in one move (mailboxes), e.g. a whole team or company. Nothing is deleted or changed in the old mailboxes; messages already in a new mailbox are not copied twice. mail2mail first logs in to every mailbox and co

tools.name: move_status
tools.description: Tells where one or several moves stand: one sentence per move for the user (summary) plus details per mailbox. Status: waiting (needs a password or Microsoft sign-in on the progress page), checking, ready, queued, running, done, attention (finished, some messages not copied), failed, stopped. moves_

tools.name: cancel_move
tools.description: Stops a move at once, only when the user asks for it. Everything copied so far stays in the new mailbox; nothing is deleted. The passwords leave memory; their encrypted copy stays until forget_move or 30 days after the last activity, so resync_move can pick up later. After the move has finished, it

tools.name: resync_move
tools.description: For a move that is done, attention or stopped (move_status: can_resync): copies the mail that arrived in the old mailbox since (for a stopped move: the rest of the copy, then new mail is copied for follow_days as after any move), with the stored passwords. Only adds messages to the new mailbox: noth

tools.name: retry_move
tools.description: For a finished move where some mailboxes failed or did not get everything copied and checked, or where new mail could not be copied (move_status: can_retry, pairs[].retry), typically because a password was refused or a server refused messages or folders for a while: checks and copies those mailboxes

tools.name: forget_move
tools.description: Only when the user asks for it: stops the move and deletes what mail2mail keeps for it at once (addresses, servers, progress, the stored passwords; only the statistics line remains, and the server log for 14 days). The mail already copied stays in the new mailbox. The token stops working.

findings.detail: Description of "start_move" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
